title: Over and Back
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：over　|　正文 306 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 over 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Over, in 1980 the researcher carried the tube at the bench, and everybody in the lab said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning: the researcher had carried the tube ② over in silence, and nobody had asked a single question. The researcher had come to the lab two terms earlier, and spoke little of the lab he had left behind him.

The paper for February 1974 puts it plainer. The tube was ③ over, and the student who kept it wrote of the tube ④ over in the same line; nothing in the lab was ever left over for long in those days. The student wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every term thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ over, and ⑥ Over came the student who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the lab had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1987 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the paper. What the line asked for was that the tube be tested ⑦ over at the bench, and that everybody be ⑧ over before the February rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried over.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1990 she carried the tube ⑨ over twice over when nobody else would, and ⑩ Over, she said in 1992, that was the part the lab never forgot; the paper still speaks of it over. She kept the tube in the same bench for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the lab never forgot how over it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 越过（句末状语，置于宾语之后：carried the tube over，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 越过（作表语，说明处所或去向：the tube was over）
C. adv. 在那边（置于句首：Over, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 在那边（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the tube over）
E. adv. 在那边（作介词宾语：from over）
F. adv. 在那边（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Over came the student）
G. adv. 越过（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be tested over at the bench）
H. adv. 越过（be over 说明所在或去向：everybody be over before the rains）

answers.why: over 意为“在那边”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Over, in 1980 …。
over 意为“越过”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had carried the tube over。
over 意为“越过”，此处作表语说明那件细细的试管的去向或所在：was over。
over 意为“在那边”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the tube over。
over 意为“在那边”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from over。
over 意为“在那边”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Over came the student。
over 意为“越过”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be tested over at the bench。
over 意为“越过”，be over 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
over 意为“越过”，1990 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次搬过那件细细的试管，副词置于句末。
over 意为“在那边”，母亲 1992 年那句话以地点状语开头：Over, …。

叔叔是从越过回来的。（from over）
